title: Programmable fill defaults to 45° (the project's psc-square-4pt tile)
description: A new programmable fill on a 40 × 40 mm square with the project's own closed square tile (psc-square-4pt.pas at 7.5 × 7.5 mm) is sewn at the guide's default direction, 45°, which PE-DESIGN measures counter-clockwise on screen: the stitch direction carrying the most length is 135° ±1° (angles measured from +x towards +y, the file's y axis pointing down), and the stored angle is 45. The reference replaces the withdrawn capture of PE-DESIGN's built-in pattern (#1060, #1075).

evidence.note: the programmable fill example is captioned "45° (default)"

references.make: Programmable Stitch Creator, New Fill/Stamp Pattern: the closed square (128,128) (896,128) (896,896) (128,896), Save As psc-square-4pt.pas (round 4). Layout & Editing, 100 x 100 mm page: Rectangle 40 x 40 mm at (10, 10) mm, line Not Sewn, region Prog. Fill Stitch, its folder button (Browse) > psc-square-4pt.pas, every other setting as PE-DESIGN sets it (Direction 45). Save As PES. Never choose a pattern from PE-DESIGN's own list.

measurements.evidence: audit item 14; PE-DESIGN 11.50 reference stitches/programmable-fill-45-psc-square.pes (the project's square tile, Direction 45 as PE-DESIGN sets it): the dominant direction of its stitches, ±1°
